item.title: For likely the first time in modern history, the Supreme Cou…
item.author: ProPublica (@propublica.org)
item.description:
For likely the first time in modern history, the Supreme Court decided more cases in fast-tracked, secretive proceedings than in open court.

These “shadow docket” decisions have let the Trump admin. bypass lower courts on deportations, ICE stops and more — often with little to no explanation.

item.title: One fan’s review of ESPN putting Ted Cruz on College GameDay…
item.author: Donna Stern (@dvsmemphis.bsky.social)
item.description:
One fan’s review of ESPN putting Ted Cruz on College GameDay in Austin this morning: “gross.” Another said just switch the channel. The crowd didn’t wait for a punchline; they booed him nonstop through the whole Rece Davis interview, live, in his own state.
#momsky#sheshed
